The prior 94cfd418 attestation is superseded for Web/Wasm and iOS because those edges did not prove real captions and used insufficient physical export validation.
Web/Wasm and iOS no longer burn the CaptionTemplateStyle name as fake captions. If captions are selected without a real transcript, export fails closed instead of producing a misleading artifact.

Web/Wasm now reads real video metadata at export time, records actual duration, applies crop/backgroundCropRect against the source video aspect, exports a physical WebM blob, and verifies the blob with ffprobe for 1080x1920 video and no audio stream after mute.
iOS now reads AVFoundation metadata instead of assuming 90 seconds, passes backgroundCropRect to AVFoundation, and compiles the updated bridge at exact SHA.
Android remains the functional reference for automatic captions because it owns Vosk model delivery, audio decode/transcription and Media3 caption burn-in.

GO requires implementing or approving a real Web/Wasm and iOS caption transcript provider/burn-in path equivalent to the Android Vosk path; tests must validate the physical caption result, not only operations=true.
